in_marathi.name: Pradyumn
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Light, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pradyumn हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pradyumn is derived from the Sanskrit word pradīpta, which means 'shining forth'. This name is associated with the sun and represents the light of knowledge and wisdom.
